kaempferol.notes: Arghel (S. argel) major flavonoid aglycone; a practical simulation target.

quercetin.notes: Arghel major flavonoid aglycone; a practical simulation target.

isorhamnetin.notes: Arghel major flavonoid aglycone (3'-O-methyl quercetin); a practical simulation target.

benzotriazole.notes: Reference / benchmark corrosion inhibitor for comparison.

phytic acid.notes: myo-Inositol hexakisphosphate (C6H18O24P6). Validation target for the phytic-acid case study (Chidiebere 2014, Fe(110) / 0.5 M H2SO4).

pyrazolopyrimidine propanoic acid.notes: 3-(3-methyl-1-phenyl-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-yloxy)propanoic acid (C15H14N4O3). Novel compound 1 from Awad et al., Sci. Rep. 15:32576 (2025); validation target for the pyrazolo-pyrimidine case study (Fe(110) / HCl).

pyrazolopyrimidine propanamide.notes: 3-(3-methyl-1-phenyl-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-yloxy)propanamide (C15H15N5O2). Novel compound 2 from Awad et al., Sci. Rep. 15:32576 (2025); validation target for the pyrazolo-pyrimidine case study (Fe(110) / HCl).

pyrazolopyrimidine ethyl ester.notes: ethyl 3-(3-methyl-1-phenyl-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-yloxy)propanoate (C17H18N4O3). Novel compound 3, the reported lead (smallest gap, strongest adsorption), from Awad et al., Sci. Rep. 15:32576 (2025); validation target for the pyrazolo-pyrimidine case study (Fe(110) / HCl).

trimethoprim.notes: 5-[(3,4,5-trimethoxyphenyl)methyl]pyrimidine-2,4-diamine (C14H18N4O3). PubChem CID 5578. Validation target for the tmp-smx case study (Odozi 2026, Al(111) / 1 M HCl).

sulfamethoxazole.notes: 4-amino-N-(5-methyl-1,2-oxazol-3-yl)benzenesulfonamide (C10H11N3O3S). PubChem CID 5329. Validation target for the tmp-smx case study (Odozi 2026, Al(111) / 1 M HCl).

tetrazole.notes: 1H-tetrazole (CH2N4). PubChem CID 67519. Validation target for the tetrazoles case study (Bourzi/El Issami 2020, Cu(111) / acidic HNO3); the bare parent, weakest inhibitor.

5-aminotetrazole.notes: 5-amino-1H-tetrazole (CH3N5). PubChem CID 20467. Validation target for the tetrazoles case study (Bourzi/El Issami 2020, Cu(111) / acidic HNO3).

5-phenyltetrazole.notes: 5-phenyl-1H-tetrazole (C7H6N4). PubChem CID 87425. Validation target for the tetrazoles case study (Bourzi/El Issami 2020, Cu(111) / acidic HNO3); phenyl on C5 per the source figure (the abstract's '1-phenyl' is a naming slip).

1-phenyl-5-mercaptotetrazole.notes: 1-phenyl-1H-tetrazole-5-thiol (C7H6N4S), thiol tautomer as drawn in the source figure. PubChem CID 690730 (canonicalised there as the 5-thione). Validation target for the tetrazoles case study (Bourzi/El Issami 2020, Cu(111) / acidic HNO3); the mercapto S makes it the reported strongest inhibitor.

pyrazolylnucleoside methyl.notes: 2-[1-(2-deoxyribofuranosyl)-5-(4-methylphenyl)-1H-pyrazol-3-yl]acetonitrile (C17H19N3O3). Novel pyrazolylnucleoside 5a (para-CH3) from Oukhrib et al., Sci. Rep. 11:3771 (2021); SMILES read from the source Figure 1. Validation target for the pyrazolylnucleosides case study (Cu(111) / acidic). Flat (non-stereo) sugar SMILES for the frontier-orbital screen.

pyrazolylnucleoside methoxy.notes: 2-[1-(2-deoxyribofuranosyl)-5-(4-methoxyphenyl)-1H-pyrazol-3-yl]acetonitrile (C17H19N3O4). Novel pyrazolylnucleoside 5b (para-OCH3) from Oukhrib et al., Sci. Rep. 11:3771 (2021); SMILES read from the source Figure 1. Validation target for the pyrazolylnucleosides case study (Cu(111) / acidic).

pyrazolylnucleoside fluoro.notes: 2-[1-(2-deoxyribofuranosyl)-5-(4-fluorophenyl)-1H-pyrazol-3-yl]acetonitrile (C16H16FN3O3). Novel pyrazolylnucleoside 5c (para-F) from Oukhrib et al., Sci. Rep. 11:3771 (2021); SMILES read from the source Figure 1. Validation target for the pyrazolylnucleosides case study (Cu(111) / acidic).

pyrazolylnucleoside chloro.notes: 2-[1-(2-deoxyribofuranosyl)-5-(4-chlorophenyl)-1H-pyrazol-3-yl]acetonitrile (C16H16ClN3O3). Novel pyrazolylnucleoside 5d (para-Cl) from Oukhrib et al., Sci. Rep. 11:3771 (2021); SMILES read from the source Figure 1. Validation target for the pyrazolylnucleosides case study (Cu(111) / acidic).

pyrazolylnucleoside bromo.notes: 2-[1-(2-deoxyribofuranosyl)-5-(4-bromophenyl)-1H-pyrazol-3-yl]acetonitrile (C16H16BrN3O3). Novel pyrazolylnucleoside 5e (para-Br) from Oukhrib et al., Sci. Rep. 11:3771 (2021); SMILES read from the source Figure 1. Validation target for the pyrazolylnucleosides case study (Cu(111) / acidic); the reported strongest adsorber.
